Name: Hanniel, Son of Ephod
Summary: Hanniel, Son of Ephod was the prince of Manasseh appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Hanniel was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
